@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Bruce got the second-hand book at a flea market; it was a real b______n.
= bargain
~詞義 bargain（n.）便宜貨
~原文 Bruce got the second-hand book at a flea market; it was a real bargain.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Beatrice screamed loudly when she stepped into the bathroom and saw a g______c cockroach on the wall.
= gigantic
~詞義 gigantic（adj.）巨大的
~原文 Beatrice screamed loudly when she stepped into the bathroom and saw a gigantic cockroach on the wall.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The cook poured milk into the bowl and mixed it with the other i______ts thoroughly.
= ingredients
~詞義 ingredient（n.）原料;成分
~原文 The cook poured milk into the bowl and mixed it with the other ingredients thoroughly.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Instead of adding chemical fertilizers to the soil, the farmer uses organic methods to keep the land f______e.
= fertile
~詞義 fertile（adj.）肥沃的
~原文 Instead of adding chemical fertilizers to the soil, the farmer uses organic methods to keep the land fertile.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Daisy's i______t into the group project improved the structure and flow of the final presentation.
= input
~詞義 input（n.）投入;參與
~原文 Daisy's input into the group project improved the structure and flow of the final presentation.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The suspect is ______ of armed robbery and now faces a trial.
A: rescued
B: accused
C: clarified
D: giggled
= B
~詞義 accuse（v.）控告
~原文 The suspect is accused of armed robbery and now faces a trial.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Make sure to leave some space in the ______ of each page.
A: knobs
B: spades
C: refunds
D: margins
= D
~詞義 margin（n.）頁邊空白
~原文 Make sure to leave some space in the margins of each page.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Everyone knows not to trust what Billy says because he is such a ______.
A: voyage
B: basin
C: plum
D: liar
= D
~詞義 liar（n.）說謊者
~原文 Everyone knows not to trust what Billy says because he is such a liar.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: As the sun sank slowly toward the horizon, the shadows began to ______.
A: clarify
B: giggle
C: lengthen
D: refund
= C
~詞義 lengthen（v.）變長
~原文 As the sun sank slowly toward the horizon, the shadows began to lengthen.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: A(n) ______ storm struck the coast, forcing residents to stay indoors until conditions improved.
A: fierce
B: tense
C: divine
D: oval
= A
~詞義 fierce（adj.）兇猛的;殘暴的
~原文 A(n) fierce storm struck the coast, forcing residents to stay indoors until conditions improved.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: concrete
B: elsewhere
C: overnight
D: overcoat
E: skyscraper
F: nightmare

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The boy woke up crying because of his horrible ______.
= F
~詞義 nightmare（n.）惡夢
~原文 The boy woke up crying because of his horrible nightmare.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The man put on a thick ______ and walked into the snowy night.
= D
~詞義 overcoat（n.）大衣
~原文 The man put on a thick overcoat and walked into the snowy night.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: It had snowed ______, so when I looked outside in the morning, the world was completely covered in white.
= C
~詞義 overnight（adv.）在晚上
~原文 It had snowed overnight, so when I looked outside in the morning, the world was completely covered in white.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sandy encouraged her students to use ______ examples instead of vague ideas to strengthen their essays.
= A
~詞義 concrete（adj.）具體的
~原文 Sandy encouraged her students to use concrete examples instead of vague ideas to strengthen their essays.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The Empire State Building, probably the most famous ______ in the world, was completed in 1931.
= E
~詞義 skyscraper（n.）摩天大樓
~原文 The Empire State Building, probably the most famous skyscraper in the world, was completed in 1931.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: ginger
B: rescue
C: chew
D: inflation
E: refund
F: marathon

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lifeguard came to the swimmer's ______ after noticing him struggling against the strong waves.
= B
~詞義 rescue（n.）援救某人(come to one's rescue)
~原文 The lifeguard came to the swimmer's rescue after noticing him struggling against the strong waves.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: After the ______, the runner was exhausted and was covered in sweat.
= F
~詞義 marathon（n.）馬拉松
~原文 After the marathon, the runner was exhausted and was covered in sweat.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The angry customer is yelling at the manager and asking for a(n) ______ because the air-conditioner that he bought yesterday isn't working.
= E
~詞義 refund（n.）退款
~原文 The angry customer is yelling at the manager and asking for a(n) refund because the air-conditioner that he bought yesterday isn't working.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is very rude to ______ gum at formal occasions such as weddings or meetings.
= C
~詞義 chew（v.）咀嚼
~原文 It is very rude to chew gum at formal occasions such as weddings or meetings.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ rate has been on the rise for many years, so the cost of living nowadays is much higher than it used to be.
= D
~詞義 inflation（n.）通貨膨脹
~原文 The inflation rate has been on the rise for many years, so the cost of living nowadays is much higher than it used to be.
